problem: The chapter says in BLSR/MS-SPRing that working capacity is shared. In a BLSR/MS-SPRing, the protection capacity is shared; working capacity is not shared.
fix: In a BLSR (bidirectional line switched ring) or MS-SPRing, protection capacity is shared and working traffic loops back at a failure.

problem: The sentence says one column is path overhead and then says the remaining 87 columns form the SPE. This can make students think path overhead is outside the SPE, although path overhead is inside the 87-column SPE.
fix: Of the 90 columns, 3 are transport overhead. The other 87 columns form the SPE; the first column of the SPE is path overhead.

problem: The answer lists unused VC-4 capacity as part of the remaining capacity. With 63 E1s mapped into a VC-4, the VC-4 payload is occupied by the E1 mappings and their VC-12/TU overhead and stuffing; there is no unused VC-4 capacity to count.
fix: Remove unused VC-4 capacity from the answer. Say the rest is STM-1/SDH transport and path overhead, plus VC-12/TU pointers and stuffing.
